Available in cPanel 66 and later. This function activates PHP-FPM for any non-PHP-FPM domains on a server.

**Important:**

When you disable the [*Web Server*](https://go.cpanel.net/howtouseserverprofiles) role, the system **disables** this function.

**Warning:**

We **strongly** recommend that you only activate Apache PHP-FPM if your server has at least 2 GB of RAM available, or at least 30 MB of RAM per domain. If you enable PHP-FPM on a server with less than the required RAM, your server may experience severe performance issues.

Converts existing non-PHP-FPM domains server-wide. The returned build_id identifies a log file, not successful completion or application availability. Configuration can change immediately; no retry or rollback is provided.

**Important**:

Writes only /etc/cpanel/ea4/profiles/custom/. filename, display name and packages are required; optional desc defaults to empty string, overwrite to 0, tags to an empty list and version to the string 0. Available in cPanel 11.52 and later. This function changes the contents of a PHP version's php.ini file.

**Notes:**

 - This document **only** applies to systems that run EasyApache 4.
 - Due to the limited field length of HTTP GET method calls, we **strongly** recommend that you use the HTTP POST method.

**Important:**
  When you disable the [Web Server role](https://go.cpanel.net/serverroles), the system **disables** this function.

content is sensitive caller-supplied text. The client form-encodes its exact bytes once; callers do not pre-encode them. This replaces the selected version's php.ini contents and can affect sites using it immediately. No retry or rollback is provided, and no server write/read round trip is established by offline coverage. The documented opaque object result is required; an absent or null data member is not inferred as success.

**Warning:**

least 2 GB of RAM available, or at least 30 MB of RAM per domain. If you enable PHP-FPM
on a server with **less** than the required RAM, your server may experience severe

version accepts custom PHP package names and inherit. Multiple vhosts use numbered fields vhost, vhost-1, and so on. Omitting phpFpm retains the documented default 0; explicit false is sent as 0. phpFpmPoolParms must be caller-supplied JSON text containing pm_max_children, pm_max_requests and pm_process_idle_timeout; the source declares those properties required and defaults them to 5, 20 and 10. The client sends the text once in the form field without JSON encoding or decoding, does not validate its inner schema, and retains the existing string|int|null scalar boundary (whm-api-client-8x0.1.23). Treat this configuration text as sensitive. Version and FPM changes can affect existing sites immediately; no retry or rollback is provided.
